title: docs(site): link store badges on the marketing site
body:
**Priority:** P2  
**Size:** XS  
**Branch:** `gh-pages`

The marketing site's App Store and Google Play badges link to `#`. The share feature links to this site, so it has to lead somewhere.

### Work

- [x] App Store badge → the live App Store URL once 1.0.0 is approved
- [ ] Google Play badge → the Play URL once production is live; until then, keep it clearly "coming soon" (the closed-test opt-in link must **not** go here)
- [ ] Update the badge `aria-label`s to match

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No badge links to `#` for a store where the app is live
why: XS, but it publishes gh-pages and touches the store-badge rule while Play is not live: the skill asks.
